stock.description: Operating within the People's Republic of China, Green International Holdings Limited delivers a variety of beauty and wellness offerings. The company's operations are segmented into its Health and Medical Business and Beauty and Wellness Business. Under its Health and Medical division, it runs hospitals and hemodialysis centers, providing specialized care in areas like internal medicine, nephrology, surgery, traditional Chinese medicine, ultrasound diagnostics, electrocardiography, medical laboratory services, and medical imaging. Additionally, the company engages in securities brokerage and asset management. Established in 2006, Green International Holdings Limited was previously known as Smart Union Group (Holdings) Limited, undergoing its name change in April 2012. Its main offices are situated in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
